children: U.S. President Donald Trump has proposed a $5,000 “Trump dividend” for every adult U.S. citizen if Republicans retain control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate in November’s midterm elections.

Trump made the pledge Wednesday at the Republican Party’s first midterm convention in Dallas, saying the administration could afford the payments because “we’ve done so well and because our country is making so much money.”
With about 270M U.S. adults, the proposed payments would cost an estimated $1.35T. U.S. national debt has topped $40T.

“Here is my promise: if the Republicans win the House of Representatives and the United States Senate, both of them … because of our tremendous strength and success economically, I will issue a dividend to every adult citizen in the United States of America for $5,000,” Trump said.
“The only caveat I have is that the dividend that we're making must be spent in the United States of America,” he added.
“We don’t want you going to Canada to spend the money,” Trump said. “We don’t want you going to China, to Germany.”
Vice President JD Vance later suggested the payments could exclude wealthy Americans and be funded with tariff revenue, although no formal details of the plan have been announced.
For now, the proposal remains a campaign pledge rather than an established federal program, with Congress still needing to approve any legislation needed to deliver the payments.
Trump has floated similar proposals before. Last year, he promised $2,000 tariff-funded dividend checks for Americans but provided few details on how the payments would work.

title: Trump offers $5,000 to every U.S. adult ahead of midterms
